description: Test file for logger configuration and log path validation in Mattermost server, including tests for audit config, log root path, and log file path validation.

methods.name: TestMloggerConfigFromAuditConfig
methods.description: Tests the creation of logger configuration from audit settings, verifying default values and format options.

methods.name: TestGetLogRootPath
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of the log root path, including environment variable override and fallback to directory search.

methods.name: TestValidateLogFilePath
methods.description: Tests validation of log file paths, including checks for paths within root, outside root, traversal attacks, symlinks, and non-existent files.
